description: Advanced technical NBT automation fabric mod that brings modern support for legacy Minecraft maps.

mods.name: Legacy Bridge
mods.description: Converts legacy (1.8-1.12.2) Minecraft maps to 1.21.10 — migrates command block syntax, resource packs, and block data values.

Migrates 1.0 --> 1.12.2 Maps to 1.21.10
